area: mdl/executor flow splice + modelsdk/canon + layout flows
symptom: A loop whose body @position was written in canvas coordinates got a box as wide as that x (body at 1200 -> box 1310 wide) covering its neighbours, and nothing could shrink it: create or modify with the body moved was refused (MDL-V1-REBUILD) or, with the statement spelled otherwise than describe prints it, reported the flow unchanged; layout flows said 'moved' and left the box at its size (ako/mxcli#2564, mendixlabs/mxcli#1935).
cause: Four layers: (1) body @position is in the loop box's coordinates (as Mendix stores it), undocumented, so the box correctly grew to reach a canvas-frame body; (2) the splice refused any node moved inside a loop body, and its in-place replace of a same-kind body activity drew it where it was stored, dropping the stated position silently; (3) canon.carryLoopSize (#2179) never lets a box shrink on any write, patches included; (4) stripFlowLayout did not clear the @size/@merge sizes #2369 added, so layout flows rebuilt every loop at its stored size, and wrote through the rebuild path, which carried it back anyway.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify_patch.go (movedInLoop, fitLoop, flowMove.fit), cmd_flow_modify.go (inLoopBody, bodyGap, patchSummary), mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (Move via anyNode, FitLoop), modelsdk/canon/unexpressed.go (carryUnexpressed patch flag), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_layout.go (strip Size/MergeSize, UpdateRawUnitPatch)
fix: The splice moves body nodes in the box's coordinates and then fits the box to the moved body as create sizes it (or to a stated @size), keeping its centre and refusing a box drawn over a neighbour; a patch write (ContentsOwnElementIDs) skips carryLoopSize; layout flows strips Size/MergeSize and writes as a patch. syntax microflow.layout and write-microflows state the body frame.
insight: The test that settles it is 'the same script, freshly created under another name, draws the same box' — it needs no expected numbers and caught the canon carry after the splice change already looked right (the mutator set 260x180 and the stored unit still read 710x380). A protection added for rebuilds (carryLoopSize) applied to every write: a carry keyed on 'MDL cannot state X' has to be revisited when MDL learns to state X (#2369 added @size; neither the carry nor stripFlowLayout was updated). Also: a stated position that an in-place replace ignores is a silent drop, not a refusal — check what 'unchanged' means when the script changed.
test: mdl/executor/flow_splice_loop_body_move_2564_pedapp_test.go (described and other spelling; layout flows refit + idempotent); mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice_fitloop_2564_test.go; each of the layout, canon and splice changes reverted fails its test with the reported box; live on TestApp 11.14.0: repaired flow mx check 0 errors, no MPR008/MPR011, re-run unchanged
